identity.lineage: Crossover (drawn the same day) with its closing weeks spread, on the owner's ask of 7 Nov 2026: "Middle ground is a reworking of common ground to make it a gentle change between weeks. As people don't want to do several weeks of closes. How possible is it to do the same to crossover?", then "Do it". Crossover's four closing weeks sat side by side; here no two do. Its rest days, its early and late weeks and each day's duties are Crossover's, so its leave, weekends, December rules, fit to the trains and fatigue checks are too. Keeping its 06:20 weeks apart as well was measured and set aside: Crossover has five 06:20 starts every weekday, and keeping them apart costs a start that moves over two hours a week on average
